unlisted_practices: Maintain diversity and quality of LLM training data by deliberately including varied and novel human-generated content to mitigate self-referential learning loops.
Apply stringent quality assurance measures to health care-specific fine-tuned LLMs.
Target LLM use to high-impact areas and design systems that prioritize clarity and actionability of recommendations to minimize verification time.
Provide LLM transparency, such as detailing the literature and patient data informing a diagnostic suggestion, so clinicians can verify outputs and avoid algorithmic deference.
